answer: I would anchor trust in Proof of unique social account age with platform attestation. With an account the platform kept active across years of posts, a single trellis check quietly prices out anyone trying to run a hundred names at once. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the tundra compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the mirror of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
